variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body:
The project {project} is badly behind schedule. The delay is the established failure against its timetable, not a complete account of why it occurred. Readers considering {target} should distinguish that known position from invented shortages, contractor disputes or financial consequences not supplied in the report.

Workers know that a timetable can be treated as somebody else's promise and somebody else's problem. Labour should resist any account that makes ordinary people invisible in the question of delivery. A serious delay warrants attention without assuming that workers caused it or that speed should override decent conditions.

We defend {target} against a verdict based on the delay alone. Lateness is established, but its existence does not prove every adverse claim about responsibility or the merits of the project. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.

variants.headline: A project waits beyond its schedule
variants.sub: The project {project} is badly behind schedule.
variants.body:
The project {project} has fallen badly behind its schedule. The gap between planned timing and delivery deserves scrutiny in its own right. For {target}, responsibility should be considered without attaching an unreported overrun, contractual penalty or abandoned purpose to the fact of the project's lateness.

Workers know that a timetable can be treated as somebody else's promise and somebody else's problem. Labour should resist any account that makes ordinary people invisible in the question of delivery. A serious delay warrants attention without assuming that workers caused it or that speed should override decent conditions.

We defend {target} against a verdict based on the delay alone. Lateness is established, but its existence does not prove every adverse claim about responsibility or the merits of the project. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.
